points.why: Explains the 2-3 year construction lag and that most new units don't exist yet, but never mentions that rent data itself lags because it reflects leases signed earlier.
Warns against doing everything at once, but only because the effects can't be attributed; it doesn't mention overcorrection or a later supply wave stacking on the other measures.
Recommends quarterly tracking of permits, starts and completions, and asking what result by what date would count as success, instead of repealing now.
Recommends narrow, temporary, separately tracked measures, but doesn't mention outside forces like regional demand or interest rates driving rents.
